mode: PWAPP (full PWA with manifest + service worker)
description: W3C PWA shell — manifest-driven display, permissions, notifications, badging, share, offline, scope navigation

capabilities.expected: Window opens, loads URL. Splash screen shows during load.

capabilities.feature: Uses startUrl from metadata over argv
capabilities.test: Install PWAPP with manifest start_url. Launch.
capabilities.expected: Loads metadata startUrl, not argv URL.
Window icon loaded from metadata iconPath field.
Full-screen splash with: backgroundColor from manifest, app icon (128x128), app name, BusyIndicator.
Splash fades out (400ms animation) when LoadSucceededStatus fires.

capabilities.feature: Splash text color adapts to background
capabilities.test: PWAPP with dark backgroundColor vs light backgroundColor
capabilities.expected: White text on dark background, dark text on light background.
No URL bar. No navigation buttons. Only hamburger menu button in header.
PwaToolbar with: back/forward/reload buttons, read-only URL bar, hamburger menu.
Window starts fullscreen. No header at all.

capabilities.test: Install PWAPP with display_override:[minimal-ui, standalone] and display:standalone
capabilities.expected: Uses minimal-ui (first supported mode in display_override wins over display field).

capabilities.test: Install PWAPP with theme_color:#e91e63 and display:minimal-ui. Launch.
capabilities.expected: PwaToolbar background is #e91e63. Text white (dark background).
Toolbar text is dark (luminance-based detection).
Navigation accepted. Page loads in WebEngineView.
Navigation rejected. Qt.openUrlExternally() opens system browser.

capabilities.test: Web page requests geolocation, camera, notifications, etc.
capabilities.expected: Permission auto-granted without user prompt (installed PWA trust model).

capabilities.test: Grant permission. Close app. Relaunch. Request same permission.
capabilities.expected: Still granted. Stored in QSettings permissions/{type}.

capabilities.test: Request each: Geolocation, AudioCapture, VideoCapture, AudioVideoCapture, DesktopVideoCapture, DesktopAudioVideoCapture, Notifications, ClipboardReadWrite, LocalFontsAccess
capabilities.expected: All handled by PwaPermissionHandler. Each auto-granted by default.

capabilities.test: PWA sends notification via Notification API or push event
capabilities.expected: Desktop notification via D-Bus (org.freedesktop.Notifications). Shows app name + icon + title + body.
WebEngineProfile.pushServiceEnabled = true (if Qt version supports it).
JS polyfill emits console.info('__QAPP_CMD:badge:5'). PwaOsIntegration sends D-Bus Unity LauncherEntry signal with count=5, count-visible=true.
D-Bus signal with count=0, count-visible=false. Badge removed from taskbar.

capabilities.test: Set badge count > 0, check taskbar icon
capabilities.expected: Badge number overlay on app icon in taskbar (Unity LauncherEntry protocol).
JS polyfill emits __QAPP_CMD:share:JSON. PwaOsIntegration opens mailto: with subject=title, body=text+url.
Returns true (polyfill always returns true).
PwaHelper.isOnline becomes false. PwaOfflineIndicator red 'Offline' badge appears top-right.
PwaHelper.isOnline becomes true. Offline badge fades out (300ms opacity animation).

capabilities.test: Load PWAPP, disconnect, navigate within app
capabilities.expected: Service worker serves cached content. App continues working offline.

capabilities.test: Page loads in PWAPP. Check navigator.setAppBadge exists.
capabilities.expected: After LoadSucceededStatus, polyfillScript() injected. navigator.setAppBadge, clearAppBadge, canShare, share all available.
Polyfills re-injected on each LoadSucceededStatus.
Request accepted. Window goes fullscreen.

capabilities.test: Press F11 in any display mode
capabilities.expected: Window toggles fullscreen. Header hides in fullscreen, returns when exiting.
Exits fullscreen. Returns to normal window.

capabilities.test: Enter fullscreen first time for this appId
capabilities.expected: 'Press F11 to exit fullscreen' overlay. Fades after 3s. Never shown again for this appId.
Back, Forward, Reload, Zoom In, Zoom Out, Reset Zoom, Open in Browser, About QApp, License.
Back disabled. Forward disabled. After navigate + go back: both enabled.
Current URL opens in system default browser.

capabilities.test: Menu -> Zoom In multiple times, then Reset Zoom
capabilities.expected: Zoom factor increases +0.1 per click (max 3.0). Decreases -0.1 (min 0.3). Reset returns to 1.0.
'Reset Zoom' menu item disabled when zoomFactor ~= 1.0.
No 'QtWebEngine/' substring in user agent string.
Still logged in. ForcePersistentCookies policy.
DiskHttpCache enabled per-app.

capabilities.test: Install same PWA twice with different appIds
capabilities.expected: Separate cookies, cache, localStorage for each.
Same x, y, width, height.
Save-as dialog + download bar with progress + cancel.
Resume overlay shows. WebEngine lifecycleState set to Active (0). forceActiveFocus() called.

capabilities.feature: No false resume on quick switch
capabilities.expected: No overlay shown (500ms threshold prevents flicker).
QTWEBENGINE_CHROMIUM_FLAGS includes --max-old-space-size=N.

capabilities.test: Build with QAPP_DEV_BUILD=ON. Launch. Open chrome://inspect or localhost:9223.
capabilities.expected: DevTools available on port 9223.
